description_en: Updates the advanced configuration of a node by calling the UpdateTaskConfig operation
description_zh: 调用UpdateTaskConfig接口，更新任务高级配置
name: UpdateTaskConfig

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The node ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424711.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 任务节点ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424711.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The advanced configuration of the node. The value is in JSON string format
parameters.help_zh: 节点高级配置。取值为JSON字符串格式
parameters.name: node_config
